title: Document OCR - KYC
content:
## Motivation
Automatic understanding of documents such as invoices, contracts, and resumes is lucrative, opening up many new avenues of business. Automatic retrieval, interpretation and understanding of text from document is a huge lever ahead. [At]

## Literature Review
The main rationale for text detection described in[AT] is using a boundary box around text (FCNN), followed by a comparison with trained data for characters. These two are back by different models each. Some models are CharGrid, wordGrid, BertGrid, C+BertGrid,TableSense. In this paper the main points are layout analysis, optical character recognition, domain specific information extraction.
